figurative_meaning_en: to share or divide something equally between two parties
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমরা দুজনে হাফ-হাফ করে খরচটা দেব।
example_sentences_in_english: We'll split the expense half-half between us.
note: Often used in contexts of cost-sharing or dividing resources equally, with possible rural connotation from 'বখরা' (goat)
